title: Prime Minister shares a Sanskrit Subhashitam, highlighting determination, perseverance, and continuous effort in overcoming life's challenges
body_text:
Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam today, highlighting the power of determination, perseverance, and courage in overcoming life's challenges and turning adverse circumstances into favorable ones.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
"दैवं पुरुषकारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम्।
न दैवेन विपन्नार्थः पुरुषः सोऽवसीदति॥"
A person who possesses the determination, perseverance and courage to turn adverse circumstances into favorable ones is never defeated by the challenges of life. Instead, through continuous effort and unwavering resolve, he moves forward and ultimately achieves success.
दैवं पुरुषकारेण यः समर्थः प्रबाधितुम्। न दैवेन विपन्नार्थः पुरुषः सोऽवसीदति॥ pic.twitter.com/EIKEcyk2Bk — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 13, 2026
***
MJPS/SS/PRK

enrichment.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam (verse of wisdom) on social media platform X on 13 August 2026, emphasizing determination, perseverance and courage as means to overcome life's adversities. The verse conveys that a person with resolve is never defeated by fate but achieves success through continuous effort.
enrichment.context: This is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing an inspirational Sanskrit quote, a practice he frequently engages in to connect with cultural and philosophical traditions of India. Such posts often aim to motivate citizens and do not reflect any policy announcement, governmental decision, or administrative action. While Sanskrit subhashitas and Indian philosophical thought are part of India's cultural heritage, this particular release carries no substantive policy, governance, or socio-economic content relevant to competitive examination preparation.
